title: The Silent Spire Anew
author: Ivo Almeida
blurb: Elodie Voss, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
